evidence: Unsigned protocol recipes are compatible with published @poa-box/core 2.1.0 and the 2.2.0 candidate. Complete browser runtime workflows are described separately in browser-features.v1.json; these recipes do not grant consent or deployed-data guarantees.

recipes.title: Resolve supported organization modules

inputs.name: client
inputs.description: Host-configured public indexed reader; no signer or environment lookup.

inputs.name: orgIdOrName
inputs.unit: bytes32 org ID or exact name
inputs.description: An explicit organization on the selected chain.

inputs.name: chainId
inputs.description: Keep endpoint and organization scope on this chain.

steps.instruction: Resolve the supported organization with resolveOrgModules(client, orgIdOrName, chainId).
Treat nullable optional module addresses as absent. For current authority/permissions obtain complete pinned authority evidence separately.

outputs.description: Promise<OrgModules>; optional modules are nullable; errors reject rather than produce an empty organization.

branches.when: read rejects or organization is retired/unready
branches.action: Surface unavailable; do not substitute another org or invent module addresses.
Use addresses to prepare inputs; this does not prove write authorization.

hostActions: No signing, publication or dispatch; host owns read scheduling and cancellation.

retry.safeToRepeat: Repeat current scoped bounded reads; retain incomplete/unknown evidence.
retry.afterUncertainty: Keep the original unsigned recovery barrier. No automatic resend.

recipes.title: Prepare an unsigned task with explicit raw reward

inputs.name: taskManagerAddress
inputs.description: Resolved deployed current TaskManager.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.description: Exact TaskManager project ID; not a subject ID.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Reviewed task title.

inputs.name: payoutRaw
inputs.unit: positive raw participation-asset base units, uint96 and <=1e24
inputs.description: Never human Shares or native value; no automatic amount derivation.

inputs.name: metadataHash
inputs.unit: zero bytes32, nonzero bytes32 or CIDv0
inputs.description: Explicit zero means no metadata; otherwise store canonical bytes separately.

inputs.name: features
inputs.description: Current signature requires deadlines:true; a caller flag is not deployment proof.

inputs.name: absoluteDeadline
inputs.description: Zero disables absolute cutoff.

inputs.name: completionWindow
inputs.description: Zero disables completion window.

inputs.name: bountyToken / bountyPayoutRaw
inputs.unit: EVM address / raw selected-asset base units
inputs.description: Supply the nonzero token and positive raw amount together; not native intent.value.

steps.instruction: Build canonical metadata if needed; publishing it is an explicit host-approved step outside this pure recipe.
Call buildCreateTaskRaw with exact deployed features and reviewed raw inputs.
Preview the returned intent. Hand off only after current permission/funding checks and host approval.

outputs.description: TxIntent, not a status wrapper; no metadata publication, signing or sending occurs.

branches.action: Keep the form and correct invalid amounts/IDs/features; no dispatch occurred.
Unsigned preparation only; unknown authorization cannot be treated as approval.

hostActions: Host must obtain approval and persist exact unsigned identity under an account lock before any real wallet dispatch; this pure preparation never sends.
If content must be published, obtain separate publication approval and retain successful/uncertain receipts before retrying.

retry.safeToRepeat: Pure unsigned preparation may be repeated after correcting input; it never republishes content or sends a transaction.
retry.afterUncertainty: Keep the original unsigned recovery barrier. No automatic resend.

recipes.title: Create a role, prove its actual ID, then separately configure it

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Bind authority, executor and HybridVoting plus every referenced optional module.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.unit: trusted indexed/RPC readers and Unix-second clock
inputs.description: Separate endpoint identities; preserve source blocks, finite budgets and abort signal.

inputs.name: request
inputs.unit: create | existing | compound with typed role fields
inputs.description: Default staged create has full desired settings and no guessed subject ID.

inputs.name: publishDocument
inputs.unit: exact UTF-8 json + keccak256 digest -> CIDv0
inputs.description: Trusted optional publisher; requires separate visible approval when documents exist.

steps.instruction: Read capabilities for options only; strict review provides current/deferred effects and consequences.
Approve publication, prepare, build the enclosing proposal and revalidate after awaited setup before approved host dispatch.
Persist the unsigned original send identity and recover it read-only if uncertain.
Prove actual created subject through status; retain original requiresConfiguration. Only requested deferred settings receive a separately reviewed configuration stage.

outputs.description: RoleOperationResult<T>: ready has data/consequences; blocked/unknown have codes/prerequisites/observations and may retain publication receipts.
RoleOperationStatus.next is wait | review-creation | review-configuration | complete.

branches.action: No executable batch; retain evidence and successful/uncertain publication records.
Complete create-only workflow; do not submit an empty configuration vote.

branches.when: creation created with requested deferred settings
branches.action: Use actual subjectId and exact continuation in a separate existing-mode review.
Wait/read again; outer success or a matching name is not completion.

hostActions: Explicitly approve each publication and send independently. The envelope example invokes the approved host execute callback; it may sign and broadcast.
Host persists unsigned journals under an exclusive account lock; uncertain publication or send is recovered without automatically repeating it.

retry.safeToRepeat: Review and final revalidation may repeat reads with current scope; renew opaque handles after reload.
retry.afterUncertainty: Never repeat publication or send automatically; preserve exact bytes/digest/receipt and unsigned original call identity, then recover read-only.

recipes.title: Recover the exact original unsigned journal without resending

inputs.name: record
inputs.description: Persisted original account/chain/nonce/call/hash with ownership fence; no key or signature.

inputs.name: readers
inputs.description: Adapt the actual provider methods without fabricating missing chain/block/transaction fields.

inputs.name: candidateTxHash
inputs.description: Optional exact EOA candidate outside bounded discovery; never guessed from broad history.

steps.instruction: Under an exclusive account lock, load and normalize the original unsigned record.
Call reconcileSubmissionRecovery(record, readers, options) without a signer or send capability.
Recheck full scope/owner/attempt/revision after awaits and compare-and-clear only the exact settled record.
For governance, additionally prove the selected inner operation; a mined outer send is not configuration success.

outputs.description: SubmissionRecoveryResult with outcome.status: succeeded | failed | replaced | unknown. Pending/unavailable evidence remains unknown; retain original identity and recovery evidence.

branches.action: Keep the recovery barrier; wait or provide the exact candidate. No timeout authorizes resend.
Settle only the matching record under the original fence; expose the proven outcome, never reinterpret replacement as original success.

hostActions: Read-only reconciliation never signs or sends. Host may update or clear only the exact matching unsigned record under its scope/owner/revision fence.

retry.safeToRepeat: Read-only reconciliation may repeat with current canonical evidence and the original exact record/fence.
retry.afterUncertainty: Keep the original unsigned recovery barrier. No automatic resend.

effectsDescribe: Effects describe referenced SDK calls. Host publication, unsigned persistence, approval and wallet dispatch are separate injected capabilities; the default starter never performs real writes.
